claims.claim: Hungary has no wealth tax

sources.name: PwC: Hungary, other taxes
sources.says: Last reviewed 01 July 2026. "There are no net wealth/worth taxes in Hungary." "Interest income is subject to 13% social tax that is payable by the individual." Dividend income, "with the exception of the dividend paid by companies the shares of which are traded on an EEA stock exchange", is also subject to 13% social tax; "the base of this tax is capped at 24 times the minimum wage", reduced by other income subject to social tax. The 2026 minimum wage is given as HUF 322,800 a month. "The general inheritance and gift tax rate is 18%, and a preferential 9% tax rate applies to residential property. The transfer of property without consideration between lineal relatives (including the spouse of the deceased) is tax exempt."

claims.claim: Residents are taxed on worldwide income at a flat 15%

sources.name: PwC: Hungary, taxes on personal income
sources.says: Last reviewed 01 July 2026. "The PIT rate is 15% in the case of nearly all types of income." Hungarian tax applies to "foreign-source income, provided to an individual resident in Hungary"; dividends, interest and capital gains are taxed separately from the consolidated base.

sources.name: PwC: Hungary, income determination
sources.says: Last reviewed 01 July 2026. "Dividend income is taxable at 15% PIT"; an additional 13% social tax is payable on dividends if certain conditions are not met, "only up to a relatively low cap". A credit for foreign withholding tax is available for treaty countries up to the treaty rate.

sources.says: Undated (© 2026), on changes from 1 January 2026. "The monthly minimum wage increased from HUF 290,800 to HUF 322,800." sources.name: Act LII of 2018 on social contribution tax (net.jogtar.hu consolidated text)
sources.says: In force from 1 October 2026 ("2026.X.1."). § 1(5) lists the income taxed, with dividends at c), capital gains at d) and "a természetes személy kamatjövedelme" (interest, except on real-estate fund units) at f). § 2(1): the rate is 13% of the base. § 2(2): the tax is due until the person's income under § 1(1)–(3) and § 1(5) a)–e) reaches 24 times the minimum wage: interest (f) is not in that range. § 5(3): no tax on dividends from securities listed on an exchange in an EEA member state. Only the first 100,000 of 103,660 characters were read.

sources.name: National Directorate-General for Aliens Policing: residence permit for guest investors
sources.says: Page last edited 2026.03.03.
